strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Enemy reaches Nanbara Connection
Doctor, enemies have arrived! They are Campbellian robots!
Blast it, Ropet, hasn't the Gandor squad arrived yet!?
There appears to have been some trouble! It will take a little longer!
But... why attack this Connection now?
Don't tell me... they're after that device!?
A big fuss over wrecking one human building... Very well, attack!
Lord Garuda... Mia will help too.
Mia, I told you to stay behind...!
Yes... but, Lord Garuda...
Very well... Just don't hold me back, Mia.
Yes...
Doctor, what do we do, Doctor?
Don't panic, Ropet. All we can do is trust the Gandor squad and wait...!
The Super Electromagnetic energy used in Combattler V...
Mother ordered me to seize this facility, but...
The Connection...!
Oh! The Gandor! You've come...!
Hey, Pops!
Hyoma, Juzo, Daisaku, Chizuru, Kosuke!
Doctor!
Looks like we made it in time!
Campbellians! Ya ain't gettin' away with playin' while the cat's away!
Garuda, was it!? Haven't you learned your lesson yet!?
Curses! I haven't forgotten my last humiliation...! Face me!
But... we've got no real mobile suits. We can't win this at long range...
A close-range slugfest... Then that's my specialty.
Heh, if only we had two or three more Aura Battlers.
If we had even two or three Drumlos, things would be different...
What!? More of 'em!?
You've gotta be kidding!?
Heh heh heh, hahahahaha!
What took you so long...? So you were dawdling here, Akira Hibiki!
You're... Sharkin!? Prince Sharkin!
Even the Demon Empire shows up... I'll dispose of you all at once.
The Campbell army and the Demon Empire... Geez!
Quite the turnout. I'm so grateful I could cry!
That's right, Akira, your father...!
Sharkin! What have you done with my father... with my dad!?
Patience... He is on a volcanic island in the Atlantic.
Besides, I have no business with you this time.
No business!? Don't screw with us!
If you're attacking, it's all the same! Prepare yourself!
Then what are you after, Sharkin!?
Survive this battle and make it to the volcanic island, and I'll tell you!
Hibiki... looks like we've got no choice.
Yeah. Sharkin...
I'll beat you right here instead, then take my time rescuing my dad!
Hahahahaha! Very well!
Demon Beasts, your target is Nanbara Connection!
Don't let the early birds beat you to it! They're after the same thing!
This is not in Mother's orders, but it can't be helped.
I shall take on this Demon Empire as well.
...After the same thing...?
Are they after the Connection's Super Electromagnetic tech...?
Grr, to think you'd go this far...
Sharkin! Prepare yourself!
Akira Hibiki! I'll be waiting on the volcanic island! That will be your end!
Tch, we couldn't take him down!
...Dad.
Grr, their power is as I feared...! Curses, we withdraw!
Hyoma! He's gettin' away!
You jerk, scurrying around and running off!
That does it! Everyone, after him!
Yeah! Ya ain't gettin' away!
Wha...!? Combattler team! I won't allow you to act on your own!
He's right, Hyoma! We have to stick together...
Hyoma! Stop it!
Hey, Hazuki and Pops Yotsuya!
We'll go find the Campbellians' hideout, so look forward to it!
He's not listening at all! That kid!
Ah, youth.
We'll check in regularly! Hyoma! Don't do anything crazy, okay!?
They're gone...
All we can do is pray they pull it off.
The institute!
Ngh... we let the enemy break in...
We drove off the enemy... but lost the Combattler team.
Ugh, as if one Fujiwara weren't enough...
No, Commander Hazuki, you saved us.
Not at all. Keeping the peace on Earth is the Gandor squad's job. But...
Don't worry about Hyoma and the others. I'm sure they'll manage.
Ropet, where are Hyoma and the others?
Well... The radio jamming is very bad... I am sorry.
We lost them, huh...
We were short on fighters as it is... This is rough...
But... we can only move forward.
Let's trust in the Combattler team...
Heh, you've gotten tougher, Princess.
That's right. I trust Koji and the others who went up into space.
It's the same thing. ...Knowing Aoi and his crew, they'll manage.
Commander Hazuki, agonizing over it here won't get us anywhere.
...It can't be helped. All units, return to base.
Dr. Yotsuya, please let us know how the Combattler team is doing.
I certainly will. I'm praying for your success.
